fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
fields.description2: ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.
fields.description3: ''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the bounce.''
fields.notes:
* ''Double Up'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} can be used by either target. If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing.
* Neutral units count as valid targets to bounce.
* The bounce follows a priority order on targets behind in a certain angle:
*# 500 units in 20º.
*# 500 units in 40º.
*# 500 units in 110º.
*# {{tt|150 units|Estimated}} in 160º.
* ''Double Up's'' cast range adjusts based on '''Miss Fortune's''' {{sti|attack range}}, which can be increased by items such as {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
* The damage of a {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} shot is {{ap|20*1.5 to 120*1.5}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}} {{as|(+ 52.5% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{ap|20*1.65 to 120*1.65}} {{as|(+ 165% AD)}} {{as|(+ 57.75% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} by {{iis|Infinity Edge}} bonus critical damage.
* If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground.
** The dud lands on the ground 176 units behind the primary target and has a missile speed of 400 on its way there.
